name: The Rune-Eye Raven
text: A three-eyed ash raven that flies ahead of the operative and returns with route-memory in its beak. Once per round, use it to record an omen note before drawing threats or choosing a dangerous route.

activeEffect.text: The Rune-Eye Raven returns with a route-memory: record one omen note before the next threat draw or route choice.

acquisition: Drawn from the Artifact deck as a legendary omen companion.
Awarded by a shrine, route-memory, or battlefield-carrion event.
Recovered after clearing a Command or Signal threat from an inner-ring approach.
flavor: One eye sees the road. One eye sees the dead. The third waits for you to choose.
imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi companion card showing a large black-and-white ash raven with three glowing golden eyes, a tall black hat, spiked dark brass collar, red gem ornaments, ragged burgundy cloak, standing on a basalt outcrop above a ruined gothic-industrial battlefield. Norse-inspired omen bird mood, runic route-memory atmosphere, dark storm clouds, ember sparks, Ashen Reach style, no text.
